fixes.explanation: Jerusalem is a fair guess, friend, but the angel never says it. He tells the women that Jesus has risen and is going ahead of the disciples into Galilee. "There you will see Him." That's a whole angel with lightning for a face handing out the directions, so no need for me to improvise. The women are to go quickly and tell the disciples.

Bethany, nice try, friend, but the angel doesn't name it. His message for the women is that Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into Galilee, and there they will see Him. Then he closes with, "See, I have told you." I think that's an angel who has said it clearly and is not taking follow-up questions.
